verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents an auto-renew flag that fires before expiration, alongside manual renewal via API. Its v2 API also exposes domain lifecycle notification opt-in and acknowledgement, which plausibly covers expiry notices but never names them. Nothing in the pack documents grace or redemption windows after a domain lapses. Missing for 10: documented grace/redemption periods and restore process, explicit expiry-notice timing/content, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, renewals never surprise me — auto-renew controls per domain, expiry notices, and documented grace/redemption windows if something lapses

citations.quote: Control when and how a domain renews using two mechanisms: auto-renew (a flag that fires before expiration) and manual renewal
Manage notification opt-in preferences, retrieve notification schemas, and acknowledge domain lifecycle notifications.
